action_history.rationale: Model: Sum of 12 pseudo-Voigt components (peak_8 and peak_12 skewed/split pseudo-Voigt; peak_11 relocated to ~190 cm-1 real band) on stiff ALS-corrected near-flat baseline with non-negative constant offset; full 135-1271 cm-1 fit

result.detailed_analysis: The spectrum is confidently assigned to ARAGONITE (orthorhombic CaCO3). Band assignments against carbonate group frequencies: the dominant band at 1085.4 cm-1 (peak_8, rel. intensity 1.0) is the ν1 symmetric C-O stretch; the resolved doublet at 701.3 and 705.6 cm-1 (peaks 6 and 7) is the ν4 in-plane bend, split by aragonite's site symmetry — this doublet is the decisive discriminator from calcite, which shows a single ν4 near 712 cm-1 and no such splitting. The lattice/external modes at 142.8, 155.0, 189.5, and 213.4 cm-1 (peaks 1, 2, 11, 3) correspond to aragonite's translational/librational lattice modes (reference ~152, ~206 cm-1), with 213 being the strong lattice mode. The 272/284 cm-1 pair (peaks 4, 5) are additional lattice modes. The weaker higher-shift features at ~1111 (peak_9) and the 1206/1235 bands (peaks 10, 12) fall in the region of ν3 antisymmetric stretch / combination and overtone territory (2×ν4 near ~1460 is out of range; bands near 1200-1240 can include weak ν1+lattice combinations); these are consistent with carbonate but are weak and less individually diagnostic. Every fitted component corresponds to visible intensity — no components are parked on noise, except peak_2 (~155) and peak_9 (~1111) which are marginal (large fractional errors, degenerate eta). The baseline is genuinely near-flat (baseline_fraction ~0.11, offset ~0), so fluorescence is negligible and band intensities are trustworthy. The dominant ν1 band is asymmetric (fitted fwhm_left 4.47 > fwhm_right 2.31, asymmetry_ratio 0.52), sharper on the high-shift side; however the persistent dispersive apex residual (~±1000 counts localized at 1083.5) means the exact peak shape and thus the reported FWHM (~3.4 cm-1) and asymmetry are not fully resolved and should be treated as approximate. Overall fit quality R2=0.996, RMSE=74 counts against a 22000-count peak.

scientific_claims.claim: The mineral is identified as aragonite (CaCO3) from the ν1 band at 1085.4 ± 0.01 cm-1, the resolved ν4 doublet at 701.3 ± 0.06 and 705.6 ± 0.07 cm-1, and lattice modes at 213.4 ± 0.07 and ~152/155 cm-1 — the ν4 doublet and lattice-mode pattern distinguishing it from calcite.
scientific_claims.scientific_impact: Aragonite-vs-calcite discrimination is central to biomineralization, paleoclimate/diagenesis, and carbonate polymorph stability studies; the resolved 701/705 ν4 doublet provides an unambiguous non-destructive polymorph fingerprint.
scientific_claims.has_anyone_question: Has anyone confirmed that the resolved ν4 doublet at ~701/705 cm-1 together with lattice modes near 152/206 cm-1 uniquely identifies aragonite versus calcite in Raman spectra of carbonate samples?

result.model_type: Sum of 12 pseudo-Voigt components (peak_8 and peak_12 skewed/split pseudo-Voigt; peak_11 relocated to ~190 cm-1 real band) on stiff ALS-corrected near-flat baseline with non-negative constant offset; full 135-1271 cm-1 fit

verification_iterations.model: Sum of pseudo-Voigt profiles on a light ALS-corrected (near-flat) baseline. Components (12 total): (1) ~155, (2) ~185, (3) ~210 (sharp), (4) ~272, (5) ~284 (doublet partner), (6) ~701, (7) ~705 (doublet partner), (8) ~1088 (dominant, sharp), (9) ~1100 (shoulder), (10) ~1210 (weak, separate band), (11) ~1235, (12) ~1240 (doublet partner). Each: I·[eta·Lorentzian + (1-eta)·Gaussian]. If the 1088 band residual shows a dispersive S-shape, switch that single component to an asymmetric (skewed pseudo-Voigt) profile rather than adding a spurious peak. If the ~1235/1240 doublet resolves as a single asymmetric band after fitting, merge accordingly per residual shape.

issues.problem: The dominant peak is under-resolved: the single pseudo-Voigt (peak_8) cannot capture the peak shape, leaving a strong derivative-like oscillation (RMS/noise=190×, +2000/-800 residual swings with 3 sign-changes across the peak).

Multiple real maxima are not resolved: a clear data peak/shoulder near 142 cm-1 is missed, and oscillating residuals (7 sign-changes, RMS/noise=21.6×) indicate several unresolved bands between 140–205.
Baseline/onset mismatch: fit dips below zero (~-50) where data sits near zero, then the modeled rise to the 1085 peak diverges from data, producing a monotonic residual trend (1 sign-change).

verification_iterations.fix_applied: Re-seed existing components within the locked 14-component model: main peak pair at ~1085 and ~1112 cm-1 (fix peak_8 shape/tail), low-frequency components at ~142 and ~160 cm-1, and constrain/deduplicate the degenerate peaks near 1230; also prevent the pre-peak baseline (987–1058) from going negative.

verification_iterations.model: Sum of 12 pseudo-Voigt profiles on a light ALS-corrected (near-flat) baseline, with a fixed non-negative offset term. Each component: I·[eta·Lorentzian + (1-eta)·Gaussian], eta in [0,1]. Component re-seeding within the LOCKED 12-component model: (1) ~142 (low-freq shoulder, was ~155/pinned at 150), (2) ~160 (was ~185, now covers 155-165 shoulder cluster), (3) ~210 (sharp), (4) ~272, (5) ~284 (doublet partner), (6) ~701, (7) ~705 (doublet partner), (8) ~1085 (dominant, sharp — re-seeded from ~1088, permitted to become asymmetric/skewed pseudo-Voigt if a dispersive S-shape persists), (9) ~1112 (main-peak asymmetric tail/shoulder, re-seeded from ~1100 to capture the 1110-1115 shoulder), (10) ~1210 (weak, separate band — anchor of the 1205-1240 cluster), (11) ~1230 (single band representing the 1225-1240 region, re-seeded from ~1235 and tightly constrained), (12) ~1240 (doublet partner — to be MERGED into peak_11 as a single asymmetric band if the residual shows no resolved bimodal structure, eliminating the peak_11/peak_12 degeneracy). The dominant peak_8 may adopt an asymmetric (skewed pseudo-Voigt) profile per the locked plan's contingency rather than adding a spurious peak.

issues.problem: A clear, prominent data maximum near ~190 cm-1 (peaking ~1100 counts) is completely unmodeled — the fit runs flat through it.
Derivative/oscillatory residual across the top of the main peak persists — the skewed pseudo-Voigt still does not fully capture the peak shape.
The 213 cm-1 peak's low-frequency and high-frequency tails are mismatched (fit sits above data on the falling edge 220–255).

verification_iterations.fix_applied: Relocate one of the degenerate 1230-cluster peaks (peak_11/peak_12) to seed a pseudo-Voigt at ~190 cm-1 to capture the missing low-frequency band, and lightly retune peak_8 asymmetry to reduce the residual apex oscillation at ~1085.

verification_iterations.model: Sum of 12 pseudo-Voigt profiles on a light ALS-corrected (near-flat) baseline with a fixed non-negative offset term. Each component: I·[eta·Lorentzian + (1-eta)·Gaussian], eta in [0,1]. REVISED 12-component assignment (model remains LOCKED at 12 components): (1) ~142 (low-freq shoulder), (2) ~160 (155-165 shoulder cluster), (3) ~213 (sharp, tails to be retuned), (4) ~272, (5) ~284 (doublet partner), (6) ~701, (7) ~705 (doublet partner), (8) ~1085 (dominant, sharp, skewed/asymmetric pseudo-Voigt with retuned asymmetry/eta and lightly relaxed left/right FWHM coupling to capture the apex cusp), (9) ~1112 (main-peak asymmetric tail/shoulder), (10) ~1210 (weak separate band anchoring the 1205-1240 cluster), (11) ~190 (RELOCATED from the degenerate 1230-cluster — captures the prominent unmodeled ~1100-count band near 190 cm-1), (12) ~1230 (single asymmetric band representing the entire 1225-1240 region; absorbs the former peak_11/peak_12 cluster into one non-degenerate band). This eliminates the peak_11/peak_12 degeneracy while keeping the component count fixed at 12 and adding no spurious peak at the 1085 apex.

issues.problem: Sharp derivative-shaped residual localized at the very top of the dominant peak (±1000 counts at x≈1083.5)
Fit runs slightly above/below data on the flanks of the ~1235 band; the modeled asymmetric band peaks ~1244 while data peaks ~1240 with a flatter top
Lorentzian wing of peak_8 rises above the near-zero data before the main peak, and slightly overshoots near ~1050-1060
